description: This file is a CMake script intended to locate and set up the Nexus client library within the build system. It defines logic to find the Nexus client headers and library, and establishes a target for use in other parts of the build.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file 'nexus_config.h' within the given path suffixes to locate the Nexus client include directory.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Attempts to locate the Nexus client library 'nxclient' in the system's library paths.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes additional CMake modules, specifically 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs', to assist in handling optional components.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Standard CMake macro to finalize the process of searching for packages, setting variables indicating success or failure.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced so that they are hidden by default in CMake GUIs, hiding implementation details from the user.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported library target 'NXCLIENT::NXCLIENT' if the library is found, marking it as a C interface library.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties on the imported library target such as its location and include directories.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status or error messages during the configuration process, depending on whether the library was found.
